budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: cx5: registers AT every pin. cx4 (2741ac708) closed TT +79.9 / FF +0.10 with ONE merged flop per fork bit at the corner of its S/N column and its tap row: the die clock rule audit of its view (pinreg_audit.py, R = 288.7 ps) gives o 435.7 ps (ne) / 409.7 (se), s 315.8 ps (tap), o + s 751.5 > 683.3 (out_unreg, in_unreg, abut; reach -89.7 um) and the hops RE.se -> FE1.tap (357.8 um) and RE.ne -> FE2.tap (363.1 um) miss the die budget by 192 / 162 ps. The fork is now three ranks: a register at the W tap pin, a corner register (S/N column x, tap row y), and separate kept registers at the S pin and at the N pin (8,252 fork flops; wires <= 255 / 305 um between ranks); rdi and cfgi take a pin register too. +2 cycles tap -> se/ne, +1 cycle rdi -> rdo and cfgi -> cfgo. Same outline, pins, layers and placement by construction (the hook places pin flops at their pin and the corner rank from its neighbours). Earlier: cx1/cx2: RePlAce diverged (GPL-0305). cx3 (constructive columns, se + ne both on the E face): GRT-0116, 3,773 vertical markers at capacity 20-21 in the band y 175-225 = the se|ne seam, all x: every bit ran a ~192 um vertical between its se and ne pin, 2,031 verticals through one seam on a 90.72 um tile, plus the E-face turns (1,109 horizontal markers x 70-90). cx4 removes the y shuffle from the tile: se leaves on the S face and ne on the N face, bit k of both on ONE M3 track column (3 tracks per column, 0.108 um; M5 free), its fork flop on that column at the tap pin's y; tap pins unchanged on W. Outline 90.72 -> 259.2 um wide (vertical M3 use 1/3 by construction, no horizontal crossing of columns except each bit's own tap run). Column order chosen so every die hop S -> FE1.tap / N -> FE2.tap is <= 492.2 um per bit. RTL, bench and latency unchanged. Pin hold stages not restored (--cts gate pre-route hold positive); hold repair covers the short tap runs. cx6 (cx5 e7d91fae3 routed TT +313.57 / FF -42.82 / DRC 0: 400 failing endpoints, all pin register -> output port, se 319 / ne 81; the post-route hold ECO added 13,783 cells and stopped at -7.56): a pin flop's clk -> pad delay is below the die-context output minimum (L_min + 50 ps hold skew + 25 ps uncertainty; FF boundary clock 291.7-374.9 ps), so every flop-driven output gets a BUF -> HB4 -> BUF hold stage and every single-flop input an HB4 -> BUF stage BY CONSTRUCTION (leaf_iohold.tcl, the kit recipe 2 pin hold cells, which the tile's own placement hook had replaced), placed beside their pin flop by the hook (pin flops staggered over 4.5 x rows); hold margin 30 ps. RTL, cycles, outline and pins as cx5.
